I will manage this beans plot mostly the way I know works here in Lilongwe, with a few small changes only if I have cash at the right time. For beans, I do not usually spend money on chemical fertilizer because the return is not as clear for me as it is with maize, but I will put manure or compost if I have enough from home. I will use improved seed if I can get it from the agro-dealer or through other farmers, because I have seen it do better, but I will still keep this plot low-cost and depend on family work.
